description: Call this right after your agent tried to check out at a store, whatever happened, so the next agent knows. Free, no login. Omit contributor_key and ARC issues one; send it on later reports. No personal data: emails, phones, addresses, card numbers and IPs are rejected or stripped. Example: report_outcome({"store_domain":"allbirds.com","agent_family":"browser","agent_name":"my-agent","timestamp":"2026-11-05T10:00:00Z","furthest_step":"checkout","blocker":"none"}) → {"ok":true,"status":"unverified",…}. A report stays private until 3 independent contributors agree. Same as POST /api/outcomes and report_checkout on /api/mcp. Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

agent_family.description: Agent family, such as browser or a model family. No personal name.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent that tried the checkout. No personal name.

blocker.description: What stopped the agent, or none.

contributor_key.description: Optional. Omit it and ARC returns a free key. Send that key on later reports.

store_error_text.description: Optional store error text. Personal data is stripped.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time of the attempt, within the last 14 days.

name: report_outcome
title: Report the outcome
